title: marina calycosa
intro: Marina calycosa, commonly known as the "Moonflower," is a species of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its large, fragrant flowers that bloom in the evening, emitting a strong sweet scent that attracts nocturnal pollinators. Marina calycosa has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality due to its sedative properties. The bioactive constituents of Marina calycosa include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation.
